title: Replace blue/light-blue generated images with warm editorial palette

requirements.text: Update the app’s generated image assets to remove blue/light-blue tones and replace them with a warm neutral, editorial palette (off-white paper, warm grays, ink/charcoal), then update the frontend to reference the updated image filenames wherever they are used (header wordmark and feed hero image).

quotes: image is not good colour blue and light blue ,

acceptanceCriteria: The header wordmark image no longer contains prominent blue/light-blue colors and visually matches a warm editorial palette.
The feed page hero illustration no longer contains prominent blue/light-blue colors and visually matches a warm editorial palette.
The frontend references the updated image filenames under frontend/public/assets/generated and both images render correctly in the UI (no broken image links).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
Store and serve images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated (do not route images through the backend).
nonGoals: No changes to backend logic or data models.
No new pages or new features beyond updating the existing generated images and their frontend references.

edits: Recolor to a warm neutral editorial palette with no prominent blue/light-blue tones (story-ink-wordmark.dim_512x128.png > story-ink-wordmark-warm.dim_512x128.png)
Recolor to a warm neutral editorial palette with no prominent blue/light-blue tones (paper-stories-hero.dim_1400x400.png > paper-stories-hero-warm.dim_1400x400.png)
